directions.name: The Foundry
directions.description: Cinematic full-bleed dark factory/warehouse hero over a warm espresso-and-cream canvas. Big editorial serif headline, a '500K+ boxes' stat block, taupe/greige toned cards. Feels like a premium print house with authority.
directions.approach: A refined, cinematic, print-house authority. Full-bleed dark hero, editorial serif, warm neutral cards, subtle grain and engineered line work.
directions.rationale: For the buyer who wants a partner with gravitas — a world-class printer, not a commodity supplier. Dark cinematic authority matched with reassuring warm neutrals.

directions.name: The Standard
directions.description: Structured, friendly-corporate B2B trust. Warm off-white sections, deep navy hero + navy inverted CTA/footer, burnt-orange CTA buttons. Clean product-category cards, 'Why Choose' band, testimonials + logo wall + stats. Modern and credible.
directions.approach: A friendly, credible corporate-B2B system. Clean off-white sections, deep navy blocks, warm burnt-orange CTAs, ordered grids, honest proof.
directions.rationale: For the buyer who answers to a procurement team and needs credibility at a glance. Navy = trust, orange = action, clean cards = order.

directions.name: The Material Atelier
directions.description: Editorial, material-first, sustainable. Ivory/kraft backgrounds, subtle grain/paper texture, foil-brass micro-details, generous whitespace. Foregrounds FSC-certified eco materials + premium finishes. Calm, tactile, premium.
directions.approach: A calm, tactile, eco-luxe editorial. Ivory/kraft surfaces, paper grain, brass-foil details, material-first storytelling, generous whitespace.
directions.rationale: For the eco-conscious food/beauty brand. Warm, tactile, sustainable — the packaging feels like material you want to touch, ground in FSC-certified integrity.

directions.name: The Structural
directions.description: Precision engineering. Crisp off-white/graphite, electric cobalt accent, sharp edges, asymmetric grid, dieline/structural-geometry motif as the recurring visual signature, uppercase micro-labels + mono spec readouts. Speaks to ISO/ISTA testing and load-bearing design.
directions.approach: A modern engineering / structural-moat system. Asymmetric grid, geometric dieline motif, electric cobalt, mono spec readouts, precision and rigor.
directions.rationale: For the supply-chain director and engineering-minded buyer. Load-bearing design, ISTA testing, precise specs — the moat is the structural engineering itself.

directions.name: The Keepsake
directions.description: Ornamental luxury for Cosmetic Carla. High-contrast didone serif, ivory-blush canvas with deep aubergine inverted sections, antique-gold foil accents and line work, dramatic asymmetric focal compositions. Keepsake rigid-box positioning.
directions.approach: A dark-feminine ornamental luxury. Didone serif, ivory-blush canvas, aubergine inversions, antique-gold foil and line work, dramatic asymmetric compositions.
directions.rationale: For the beauty brand that needs a keepsake, not a container. High-contrast didone, gold foil, aubergine — the box is worth keeping.
